svg.title: How long a fault may last
svg.desc: Three panels of the robotaxi with the margin a safety goal keeps drawn in blue, and under each a time line from the fault through detection and reaction to the FTTI, with the range WP-S-04 computes from proposed margins and fault sizes: SG-01 unintended acceleration, margin 0.5 m, FTTI 500 ms to 707 ms; SG-04 unintended steering, margin 0.3 m, FTTI 447 ms to 775 ms; SG-05 creeping from standstill, margin 0.2 m, FTTI 516 ms to 894 ms.

How long a fault may last
The fault tolerant time interval: how long a fault may act before it uses up the margin a safety goal keeps. Computed, not measured.
